meta.title: Brand logo switcher
meta.description: Replace the DeepSeek Harness sidebar and home hero logo with presets (Codex, Claude, Claude Code, OpenCode, Antigravity, Cursor, OpenAI, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Kiro, Trae), a custom SVG/image and title, or hide it completely. Configure it from this plugin's page in Plugins or under Settings > General. Disabling the plugin restores the default DeepSeek Harness branding.
